en.headline: Cyclothon Carnival runs today at West Kowloon Art Park
en.dek: The free event at the Great Lawn accompanies the Hong Kong Cyclothon rides and races, with sports activities, food stalls and live performances from 6.30am to 6pm.
body: The Cyclothon Carnival takes place today at the Great Lawn of the Art Park in the West Kowloon Cultural District, running from 6.30am to 6pm with free admission.

Organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board alongside the Sun Hung Kai Properties Hong Kong Cyclothon, the carnival features a sports marketplace, food stalls, interactive zones for emerging sports such as pickleball and teqball, children’s activities, and a main stage with live music and performances.

Road closures linked to the cycling events are in force in parts of Kowloon and the New Territories. Organisers advise visitors to use the MTR to Kowloon Station or other public transport, as some car parks in the district are closed.
The carnival is open to cyclists, families and the public. Details of the day’s stage programme and access routes are available from the Tourism Board and West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 單車節嘉年華今於西九藝術公園草地舉行
zh.dek: 活動由早上6時30分至下午6時免費入場，設運動市集、美食檔及互動體驗，配合香港單車節賽事。
body: 單車節嘉年華今日在西九文化區藝術公園大草地舉行，時間由早上6時30分至下午6時，免費入場。
由香港旅遊發展局配合新鴻基產香港單車節舉辦，現場設有運動用品市集、美食檔、新興運動如匹克球及踢波體驗、兒童活動，以及主舞台現場音樂及表演。
因單車賽事，九龍及新界部分道路實施封閉。主辦方建議市民乘港鐵到九龍站或使用其他公共交通，區內部分停車場已關閉。
嘉年華歡迎單車愛好者、家庭及公眾參加。節目詳情及前往方法可向旅發局或西九文化區查詢。
